2. An empty clear drinking tumbler.
3. A realistic fish with gill cover and distinct fins swimming.
4. Cherry tree branch with pale pink blossoms and characteristic notched petals.
5. A Japanese macaque monkey with gray-brown fur and reddish bare face.
6. Fine white salt crystals in a small bowl, wooden spoon nearby.
7. A stag with branched antlers standing in woodland.
8. Whole striped watermelon with red sliced wedge and black seeds.
9. A bar of soap on dish with a few bubbles.
10. An expansive clear blue daytime sky with fluffy white clouds.
11. A realistic octopus underwater showing exactly eight arms with suckers, no extra arms.
12. A whole chicken egg and a cracked egg with shell, white and yellow yolk.
13. A natural butterfly perched on flower, two pairs of wings (four wings total), six legs.
14. A simple wooden study desk with notebook and pencil on top.
15. Ripe red tomatoes with green star shaped calyx.
16. Shiny purple eggplants with green caps.

assets.meaning: 水辺などにすむ首や足の長い鳥。白い種類のほか、灰色などの種類もいる。
assets.prompt:
Create exactly sixteen separate warm watercolor illustrations for a Japanese children’s vocabulary app in one perfectly regular 4 by 4 contact sheet. Square overall canvas, four equal columns and four equal rows, row-major order left to right then top to bottom. Every cell has a white background and generous safe margins; illustration centered completely inside its cell, no touching or overlapping neighboring cells. No text, letters, numerals, captions, labels, logos, watermarks, decorative borders or visible gridlines. Each subject must be visually clear at small size, child-friendly, natural proportions, soft paper texture, gentle warm colors, crisp identifiable silhouette. Follow the sixteen subjects in EXACT order.
Row 1, column 1: A ceramic bowl heaped with cooked white rice, steam gently rising.
Row 1, column 2: Three long thin brown burdock roots with rough earthy skin, one cut end showing pale flesh.
Row 1, column 3: A small shallow bowl filled with tiny ivory sesame seeds, a few seeds scattered nearby.
Row 1, column 4: A simple blue household trash bin with a lid and one crumpled paper inside.
Row 2, column 1: A friendly anatomically recognizable black gorilla sitting on grass.
Row 2, column 2: A gray rhinoceros with a prominent nasal horn, standing sideways.
Row 2, column 3: Two white six-sided dice with black dot pips.
Row 2, column 4: An open brown wallet with blank banknotes and a plain card inside.
Row 3, column 1: A fishing rod with handle, reel, long slender pole and hanging fishing line.
Row 3, column 2: A white heron with long neck, long legs and pointed bill standing in shallow water.
Row 3, column 3: A short wooden picket fence with evenly spaced upright posts.
Row 3, column 4: A pair of ripe red cherries joined by green stems and a leaf.
Row 4, column 1: A complete silver salmon fish with dark speckled back, swimming in clear water; not alcohol.
Row 4, column 2: A clump of bamboo grass with slender stems and long pointed green leaves.
Row 4, column 3: Sliced raw pink salmon and white fish sashimi arranged neatly on a small plate.
Row 4, column 4: A single silver eating spoon, complete handle and concave bowl.

Create a square contact sheet with exactly SIXTEEN distinct equally sized illustrations in a precise uniform 4 by 4 grid. Reading order left to right top to bottom. All objects wholly inside their cell with ample margin, thin white gutters. Warm clean children's educational picture-book watercolor, gentle outlines, simple pale backgrounds, biologically accurate animals and plants, no human faces on animals, no text labels numbers logos watermarks. Scenes:
1. Several blank white paper sheets, one corner curled.
2. An empty clear drinking tumbler.
3. A realistic fish with gill cover and distinct fins swimming.
4. Cherry tree branch with pale pink blossoms and characteristic notched petals.
5. A Japanese macaque monkey with gray-brown fur and reddish bare face.
6. Fine white salt crystals in a small bowl, wooden spoon nearby.
7. A stag with branched antlers standing in woodland.
8. Whole striped watermelon with red sliced wedge and black seeds.
9. A bar of soap on dish with a few bubbles.
10. An expansive clear blue daytime sky with fluffy white clouds.
11. A realistic octopus underwater showing exactly eight arms with suckers, no extra arms.
12. A whole chicken egg and a cracked egg with shell, white and yellow yolk.
13. A natural butterfly perched on flower, two pairs of wings (four wings total), six legs.
14. A simple wooden study desk with notebook and pencil on top.
15. Ripe red tomatoes with green star shaped calyx.
16. Shiny purple eggplants with green caps.

assets.prompt:
Create exactly sixteen separate warm watercolor illustrations for a Japanese children’s vocabulary app in one perfectly regular 4 by 4 contact sheet. Square overall canvas, four equal columns and four equal rows, row-major order left to right then top to bottom. Every cell has a white background and generous safe margins; illustration centered completely inside its cell, no touching or overlapping neighboring cells. No text, letters, numerals, captions, labels, logos, watermarks, decorative borders or visible gridlines. Each subject must be visually clear at small size, child-friendly, natural proportions, soft paper texture, gentle warm colors, crisp identifiable silhouette. Follow the sixteen subjects in EXACT order.
Row 1, column 1: Two purple sweet potatoes, one cut open to reveal yellow flesh.
Row 1, column 2: A small bowl of white granular sugar with a spoonful lifted beside it.
Row 1, column 3: A complete silver blue mackerel fish with unmistakable dark wavy stripes on its back.
Row 1, column 4: Golden desert sand dunes under a pale blue sky.
Row 2, column 1: A green branching cactus with small spines in a terracotta pot.
Row 2, column 2: A friendly gray shark swimming sideways, recognizable dorsal fin and gill slits.
Row 2, column 3: Three flat green snow pea pods, one opened to show tiny peas.
Row 2, column 4: A single empty round shallow ceramic plate, white with a blue rim.
Row 3, column 1: A bowl of fresh salad with lettuce, red tomato and cucumber slices.
Row 3, column 2: A pair of dark-lensed sunglasses with both arms visible.
Row 3, column 3: A pair of simple summer sandals with foot straps and visible open toes.
Row 3, column 4: Two triangular sandwiches showing bread, lettuce, tomato and egg filling.
Row 4, column 1: A long slender whole Pacific saury fish with silver body and blue back.
Row 4, column 2: A red child-size pedal tricycle with exactly three wheels, handlebars and seat.
Row 4, column 3: A whole red pomegranate and a cut half filled with distinct red seeds.
Row 4, column 4: A red crayfish with two large claws, segmented tail and many small legs by a stream.

CRITICAL SAFE SPACING: Every illustration must fit within the CENTRAL 70 percent of its 4x4 equal grid cell. Leave at least 15 percent of the cell white on every side. The LONG SAURY FISH at row 4 column 1 must be SMALL, SHORT IN IMAGE, entirely inside its cell with its nose and tail clear of both edges. All cells have generous white space, absolutely no objects spilling into another cell.

Each panel is independent. Row 1: (1) Water strider viewed from above on pond: elongated slim dark body, exactly six legs attached to thorax, short front pair, very long middle and hind pairs, two antennae, ripple contact points. (2) String figure ayatori: two children's hands, exactly five fingers each, red closed string loop clearly hooked around each thumb and little finger, crossed string strands tensioned between hands, credible cat's cradle string topology. (3) Unicycle: exactly one wheel, saddle centered above straight seat post, two fork blades ending at wheel axle, opposing pedal cranks directly connected to central axle, no extra hubs or rods. (5) Accurate B-flat clarinet complete: black reed mouthpiece, short barrel, cylindrical keyed upper and lower joints, shiny silver keys and round tone-hole covers, modest flared bell, no trumpet valves. (6) Whole burdock gobo roots, long thin brown irregular roots gradually tapering to very fine tips, one cut end visible. Row 3: (7) Sesame seeds close-up in small bowl and scattered seeds: tiny flattened elongated tear/oval shapes with tapered tip, ivory, not round balls. (8) One white die three-quarter view: visible top THREE pips, front ONE pip, right TWO pips, exact consistent dot spacing, no second die. Cell 8 (row 2, column 4), 行政: A municipal city-hall public-service counter. A civil servant processes a resident's application and hands back an official certificate. Small thought bubbles show public garbage collection and repaired streetlights, representing everyday government services implementing rules. NO parliament debate or legislature building.
Cell 9 (row 3, column 1), 献血: A calm fully clothed ADULT volunteer donates blood at a medical donation center. Nurse assists the arm. Tubing from the covered adult forearm runs DOWN to a collection bag resting on a small scale BELOW the arm, on a low trolley. NO hanging IV bag above the arm, no transfusion flowing into the person, no wound or exposed needle or visible puncture. The collected red liquid stays only inside the sealed bag and tubing.

Cell 11 (row 3, column 3), 後転: A backward gym roll in three small stages within one cell, on a soft mat, same person facing LEFT at start and at end. Stage left: crouching, facing left, feet flat and knees tucked. Middle: rolling BACK toward the RIGHT over a rounded back with knees tucked, feet travel over the head to the right, hands beside ears. Right: finishes crouched facing LEFT again. Never change facing direction. A curved arrow points from start to finish to the RIGHT.
Cell 12 (row 3, column 4), しりとり: Japanese shiritori word chain represented by exactly FOUR clear picture icons in order, with arrows: RED APPLE (りんご) → GORILLA (ごりら) → TRUMPET (らっぱ) → PANDA (ぱんだ). Two happy children point at the pictures. The Japanese words correctly connect GO, RA, PA. No writing is necessary; picture identities must be obvious. No monkey, orange, or deer.
Cell 13 (row 4, column 1), 血みどろ: A WHITE torn shirt lying by itself on a chair, mostly covered in RED blood stains. No body wearing it, no wounds or hurt person. A first-aid kit is nearby and a calm fully clothed adult folds a clean replacement white shirt. Non-graphic symbolic aftermath. Clearly white fabric with red stains, never a plain red shirt.
Cell 14 (row 4, column 2), 偽物: Compare a real red apple cut open with real seeds and juicy pale fruit, and a lookalike FAKE plastic red apple that has popped apart into two hollow red shells with a visible seam. A child is surprised by the plastic apple. The fake has no flesh or seeds. No two stuffed toys or identical real apples.
Cell 15 (row 4, column 3), 濡れ手に粟: Fictional metaphor: a relaxed ADULT lightly presses just ONE small button with ONE fingertip. The automatic device instantly delivers a huge pile of gold coins into a basket. Two visual emphases: tiny effort and very large reward. No gambling, no stealing, no grain, no wet hands. Illustrates making large profits with little effort.
Cell 16 (row 4, column 4), 根強い: Lasting popularity over generations: an elderly grandfather shows a sepia photograph of himself as a young boy happily playing KENDAMA, while his smiling young grandchild beside him plays the SAME traditional kendama now. Longtime affection for the same toy. One photo in the background, present people large in foreground. No tree or literal roots.

Create exactly sixteen separate warm watercolor illustrations for a Japanese children’s vocabulary app in one perfectly regular 4 by 4 contact sheet. Square overall canvas, four equal columns and four equal rows, row-major order left to right then top to bottom. Every cell has a white background and generous safe margins; illustration centered completely inside its cell, no touching or overlapping neighboring cells. No text, letters, numerals, captions, labels, logos, watermarks, decorative borders or visible gridlines. Each subject must be visually clear at small size, child-friendly, natural proportions, soft paper texture, gentle warm colors, crisp identifiable silhouette. Follow the sixteen subjects in EXACT order.
Row 1, column 1: Three earthy brown potatoes, one cut in half showing pale yellow interior.
Row 1, column 2: A rectangular soft woven rug with a simple colorful pattern lying on a floor.
Row 1, column 3: A woven bird nest containing three pale eggs resting on a branch.
Row 1, column 4: A recognizable black skunk with two bold white stripes and a fluffy raised tail.
Row 2, column 1: A neatly displayed knee-length pleated purple skirt.
Row 2, column 2: A shallow sukiyaki cooking pot filled with thin beef slices, tofu, green onion and mushrooms.
Row 2, column 3: A platter of recognizable nigiri sushi with white rice and fish toppings and two seaweed rolls.
Row 2, column 4: A small golden round jingle bell with slit opening and tiny hanging loop.
Row 3, column 1: A rolled bamboo slat window blind partly lowered against a window.
Row 3, column 2: A full-body green stegosaurus with large upright plates along its back and tail spikes.
Row 3, column 3: A thick cooked steak with grill marks on a plate beside a fork.
Row 3, column 4: A playground sandbox with sand, a small toy bucket and shovel.
Row 4, column 1: A plate of long spaghetti noodles in red tomato sauce with a fork.
Row 4, column 2: A complete playground slide with ladder, smooth sloping chute and safe side rails.
Row 4, column 3: A yellow porous kitchen dishwashing sponge with a green scrubber layer.
Row 4, column 4: A matching pair of cozy indoor slippers with open heels.

Keep each image entirely in the CENTRAL 75 percent width and height of its own equal cell. No subject can extend beyond that safe area.

7. A stag with branched antlers standing in woodland.
8. Whole striped watermelon with red sliced wedge and black seeds.

10. An expansive clear blue daytime sky with fluffy white clouds.

12. A whole chicken egg and a cracked egg with shell, white and yellow yolk.

14. A simple wooden study desk with notebook and pencil on top.

assets.meaning: 地上から上を見たときに広がっている空間。
assets.prompt:
Create a square contact sheet with exactly SIXTEEN distinct equally sized illustrations in a precise uniform 4 by 4 grid. Reading order left to right top to bottom. All objects wholly inside their cell with ample margin, thin white gutters. Warm clean children's educational picture-book watercolor, gentle outlines, simple pale backgrounds, biologically accurate animals and plants, no human faces on animals, no text labels numbers logos watermarks. Scenes:
1. Several blank white paper sheets, one corner curled.
2. An empty clear drinking tumbler.
3. A realistic fish with gill cover and distinct fins swimming.
4. Cherry tree branch with pale pink blossoms and characteristic notched petals.
5. A Japanese macaque monkey with gray-brown fur and reddish bare face.
6. Fine white salt crystals in a small bowl, wooden spoon nearby.
7. A stag with branched antlers standing in woodland.
8. Whole striped watermelon with red sliced wedge and black seeds.
9. A bar of soap on dish with a few bubbles.
10. An expansive clear blue daytime sky with fluffy white clouds.
11. A realistic octopus underwater showing exactly eight arms with suckers, no extra arms.
12. A whole chicken egg and a cracked egg with shell, white and yellow yolk.
13. A natural butterfly perched on flower, two pairs of wings (four wings total), six legs.
14. A simple wooden study desk with notebook and pencil on top.
15. Ripe red tomatoes with green star shaped calyx.
16. Shiny purple eggplants with green caps.

assets.meaning: 八本の腕に吸盤を持つ海の生き物。危険を感じると墨を吐く。
assets.prompt:
Create a square contact sheet with exactly SIXTEEN distinct equally sized illustrations in a precise uniform 4 by 4 grid. Reading order left to right top to bottom. All objects wholly inside their cell with ample margin, thin white gutters. Warm clean children's educational picture-book watercolor, gentle outlines, simple pale backgrounds, biologically accurate animals and plants, no human faces on animals, no text labels numbers logos watermarks. Scenes:
1. Several blank white paper sheets, one corner curled.
2. An empty clear drinking tumbler.
3. A realistic fish with gill cover and distinct fins swimming.
4. Cherry tree branch with pale pink blossoms and characteristic notched petals.
5. A Japanese macaque monkey with gray-brown fur and reddish bare face.
6. Fine white salt crystals in a small bowl, wooden spoon nearby.
7. A stag with branched antlers standing in woodland.
8. Whole striped watermelon with red sliced wedge and black seeds.
9. A bar of soap on dish with a few bubbles.
10. An expansive clear blue daytime sky with fluffy white clouds.
11. A realistic octopus underwater showing exactly eight arms with suckers, no extra arms.
12. A whole chicken egg and a cracked egg with shell, white and yellow yolk.
13. A natural butterfly perched on flower, two pairs of wings (four wings total), six legs.
14. A simple wooden study desk with notebook and pencil on top.
15. Ripe red tomatoes with green star shaped calyx.
16. Shiny purple eggplants with green caps.

7. A stag with branched antlers standing in woodland.
8. Whole striped watermelon with red sliced wedge and black seeds.
9. A bar of soap on dish with a few bubbles.
10. An expansive clear blue daytime sky with fluffy white clouds.
11. A realistic octopus underwater showing exactly eight arms with suckers, no extra arms.
12. A whole chicken egg and a cracked egg with shell, white and yellow yolk.
13. A natural butterfly perched on flower, two pairs of wings (four wings total), six legs.

assets.prompt:
Create ONE square 4 by 4 contact sheet, EXACTLY 16 equally sized square illustrations, white straight narrow gutters. Row-major order, four columns and four rows. Warm clear Japanese elementary-school picture-book watercolor style. Every cell is independent and fits entirely inside its square with margin. No captions, titles, numbering or watermarks. Follow each cell scene literally, especially action direction and objects.
Cell 1 (row 1, column 1), 鼻歌: A smiling child softly HUMS while tidying books. Lips are CLOSED, cheeks relaxed, a few soft music-note symbols near the closed mouth. No microphone or wide-open singing mouth. Gentle humming.
Cell 2 (row 1, column 2), 甘塩: A small grilled salmon fillet and a tiny pinch of salt between fingers. Only three tiny grains sprinkled lightly, with a happy child tasting the mild salted fish. NO pile of salt or heap of crystals. Mild and lightly salted food.
Cell 3 (row 1, column 3), 洗いざらい: A child empties every single toy block from a box onto a table. The box is tilted and visibly completely empty. All blocks are now on the table, none left inside. Meaning everything without leaving anything out. NO washing or laundry.
Cell 4 (row 1, column 4), 居座り: A stubborn fully clothed adult remains sitting on a chair with arms folded and feet firmly planted. A host stands beside the open exit door and gestures kindly for the adult to leave; seated adult clearly refuses to move. No comfortable napping.
Cell 5 (row 2, column 1), 一石二鳥: One central action: planting one fruit tree. Two clear result bubbles linked from that one tree: on the left, a basket of apples harvested; on the right, a family resting in its cool shade. One effort produces TWO good benefits. No stone or birds.
Cell 6 (row 2, column 2), 鰻登り: A shop owner is amazed by a sales chart rising very steeply from low left to high right, with coin stacks that rise steeply in the same direction. Shows rapid steep growth. NO eel or waterfall.
Cell 7 (row 2, column 3), オウンゴール: A soccer defender in a BLUE jersey accidentally kicks the ball backward into the goal guarded by their own BLUE-jersey goalkeeper. Both BLUE teammates look dismayed. An opposing RED-jersey player outside the goal celebrates. Clear ball arrow leads from BLUE defender to own goal. No mixed teammate colors.
Cell 8 (row 2, column 4), 行政: A municipal city-hall public-service counter. A civil servant processes a resident's application and hands back an official certificate. Small thought bubbles show public garbage collection and repaired streetlights, representing everyday government services implementing rules. NO parliament debate or legislature building.
Cell 9 (row 3, column 1), 献血: A calm fully clothed ADULT volunteer donates blood at a medical donation center. Nurse assists the arm. Tubing from the covered adult forearm runs DOWN to a collection bag resting on a small scale BELOW the arm, on a low trolley. NO hanging IV bag above the arm, no transfusion flowing into the person, no wound or exposed needle or visible puncture. The collected red liquid stays only inside the sealed bag and tubing.
Cell 10 (row 3, column 2), 後退: Side view of a car pointing RIGHT (headlights and hood on the right, rear tail lights on the left). A big arrow under the car points LEFT, showing reversing backward opposite the car's forward direction. Driver looks back over shoulder. Keep hood/rear and arrow unambiguous.
Cell 11 (row 3, column 3), 後転: A backward gym roll in three small stages within one cell, on a soft mat, same person facing LEFT at start and at end. Stage left: crouching, facing left, feet flat and knees tucked. Middle: rolling BACK toward the RIGHT over a rounded back with knees tucked, feet travel over the head to the right, hands beside ears. Right: finishes crouched facing LEFT again. Never change facing direction. A curved arrow points from start to finish to the RIGHT.
Cell 12 (row 3, column 4), しりとり: Japanese shiritori word chain represented by exactly FOUR clear picture icons in order, with arrows: RED APPLE (りんご) → GORILLA (ごりら) → TRUMPET (らっぱ) → PANDA (ぱんだ). Two happy children point at the pictures. The Japanese words correctly connect GO, RA, PA. No writing is necessary; picture identities must be obvious. No monkey, orange, or deer.
Cell 13 (row 4, column 1), 血みどろ: A WHITE torn shirt lying by itself on a chair, mostly covered in RED blood stains. No body wearing it, no wounds or hurt person. A first-aid kit is nearby and a calm fully clothed adult folds a clean replacement white shirt. Non-graphic symbolic aftermath. Clearly white fabric with red stains, never a plain red shirt.
Cell 14 (row 4, column 2), 偽物: Compare a real red apple cut open with real seeds and juicy pale fruit, and a lookalike FAKE plastic red apple that has popped apart into two hollow red shells with a visible seam. A child is surprised by the plastic apple. The fake has no flesh or seeds. No two stuffed toys or identical real apples.
Cell 15 (row 4, column 3), 濡れ手に粟: Fictional metaphor: a relaxed ADULT lightly presses just ONE small button with ONE fingertip. The automatic device instantly delivers a huge pile of gold coins into a basket. Two visual emphases: tiny effort and very large reward. No gambling, no stealing, no grain, no wet hands. Illustrates making large profits with little effort.
Cell 16 (row 4, column 4), 根強い: Lasting popularity over generations: an elderly grandfather shows a sepia photograph of himself as a young boy happily playing KENDAMA, while his smiling young grandchild beside him plays the SAME traditional kendama now. Longtime affection for the same toy. One photo in the background, present people large in foreground. No tree or literal roots.

Create a square contact sheet with exactly SIXTEEN distinct equally sized illustrations in a precise uniform 4 by 4 grid. Reading order left to right top to bottom. All objects wholly inside their cell with ample margin, thin white gutters. Scenes:
1. Several blank white paper sheets, one corner curled.
2. An empty clear drinking tumbler.
3. A realistic fish with gill cover and distinct fins swimming.
4. Cherry tree branch with pale pink blossoms and characteristic notched petals.
5. A Japanese macaque monkey with gray-brown fur and reddish bare face.
6. Fine white salt crystals in a small bowl, wooden spoon nearby.
7. A stag with branched antlers standing in woodland.
8. Whole striped watermelon with red sliced wedge and black seeds.
9. A bar of soap on dish with a few bubbles.
10. An expansive clear blue daytime sky with fluffy white clouds.
11. A realistic octopus underwater showing exactly eight arms with suckers, no extra arms.
12. A whole chicken egg and a cracked egg with shell, white and yellow yolk.
13. A natural butterfly perched on flower, two pairs of wings (four wings total), six legs.
14. A simple wooden study desk with notebook and pencil on top.
15. Ripe red tomatoes with green star shaped calyx.
16. Shiny purple eggplants with green caps.

assets.meaning: 歩くときに手で持ち 地面について体を支える棒。
assets.prompt:
Create a square 4 by 4 contact sheet with EXACTLY 16 equal square cells, four rows and four columns. White background with clean thin white gutters exactly at quarter boundaries. Each cell is an independent warm watercolor illustration for Japanese young children, softly textured but clear recognizable subjects, natural shapes, gentle colors. Center each subject fully inside its cell with at least 10 percent safe empty margin so cropping never cuts it. No border frame, no text, no labels, no numbers, no logos, no overlap or shared backgrounds between cells. Use row-major order left to right, top to bottom. The sixteen cells must show exactly these subjects:
Row 1, column 1: A single wooden walking cane with a curved handle, standing diagonally.
Row 1, column 2: Several spring horsetail shoots with segmented tan stems and spore cones emerging from soil, Japanese tsukushi, not horse tails.
Row 1, column 3: A green ivy climbing vine with lobed leaves clinging to a short brick wall.
Row 1, column 4: A loose mound of rich brown garden soil with small crumbs, isolated.
Row 2, column 1: A hollow cardboard tube lying sideways with a clearly visible open circular end.
Row 2, column 2: A small azalea shrub covered in vivid pink trumpet shaped flowers.
Row 2, column 3: A neatly coiled thick twisted fiber rope, isolated.
Row 2, column 4: A red camellia flower with yellow stamens and glossy dark green leaves.
Row 3, column 1: A barn swallow in flight with narrow wings, forked tail and rusty throat.
Row 3, column 2: A small ceramic bowl of dark red sweet azuki bean paste with visible whole bean grains and a wooden spoon.
Row 3, column 3: A rounded brown ceramic storage jar with a narrow open mouth.
Row 3, column 4: A closed pink flower bud on a short green leafy stem, petals not yet open.
Row 4, column 1: A small tower made of colorful wooden toy blocks in cube triangle and cylinder shapes.
Row 4, column 2: A complete fishing rod with reel, gently curved tip and visible line, no fish.
Row 4, column 3: A single clean curved metal fishing hook with an eye and small barb, isolated.
Row 4, column 4: A morning glory vine stem curling around a wooden stake with green leaves and one blue flower.

3. A brown wild boar with snout and short visible tusks.
4. A bottlenose dolphin swimming in blue sea, blowhole and horizontal tail flukes.
5. A white rabbit with long upright ears.
6. A small brown Eurasian tree sparrow with chestnut head and black cheek spot perched.
7. A whole yellow onion and cut half with concentric layers.

11. A small natural gray mouse with round ears, pointed muzzle and long thin tail.
12. A ripe red apple and cut half showing seed core.
13. A bunch of yellow bananas with one partly peeled.
14. A giant panda with natural black white fur eating bamboo.
15. A tall sunflower with yellow petals and dark central disc.

assets.meaning: 勉強や仕事をするために物を置く台。
assets.prompt: Correct the dictionary illustrations using the supplied contact sheets as reference. Make NEW exactly 3 by 3 evenly spaced grid with nine independent equal square educational watercolor illustrations, warm ivory background, scientifically accurate, entire subjects inside generous margins. NO text numbers labels borders watermark. Row1: (1) Japanese weather loach Misgurnus anguillicaudatus, long slender brown spotted cylindrical body, small rounded tail, mouth facing viewer in three-quarter angle, exactly TEN short barbels (five pairs) attached naturally around mouth and spreading radially, NOT long catfish moustache. (2) Japanese catfish Silurus asotus, broad flattened head, scaleless dark gray elongated body, exactly FOUR barbels total: two long upper-mouth barbels extending sideways and two much shorter lower-chin barbels, no extra whiskers; full fish with tail. (3) Accurate wooden soprano recorder front view, complete straight instrument mouthpiece at top with rectangular labium window, seven FRONT finger positions: upper five single round holes and bottom TWO paired small double-holes (so nine circular apertures on front total), subtle joints between head body foot. Thumb hole is on BACK hence not visible. Row2: (4) Japanese railway crossing at intersection of road and two parallel railway rails, correctly built thin straight horizontal yellow-black striped barrier arm pivoting from a roadside compact motor housing, arm crosses ROAD lane while clear train tracks stay visible, black/yellow crossing X sign and two red lamps on separate upright pole. No fence as barrier, no train or traffic in crossing. (5) Fully clothed child in T-shirt and shorts happily spinning ONE bright hoop horizontally around waist, hoop encircles waist physically and does not pass through body, full child head to shoes visible. (6) Swimwear collection laid out: blue one-piece swimsuit, boys' swim trunks, long-sleeved zippered rash guard top; separate recognisable garments all complete. Row3: (7) Small natural Japanese medaka rice fish Oryzias latipes side profile, translucent slender silver-beige body with large eyes, flat-ish back and small upturned mouth, single SMALL dorsal fin near rear, fan-shaped caudal fin NOT forked, elongated anal fin near rear, no goldfish stout body. Show two fish in sparse aquatic plants. (8) Yakitori on white plate, three parallel bamboo skewers with grilled chicken chunks, each bamboo handle protrudes at ONE end only, sharp far tip hidden completely inside last chicken chunk. (9) FULL small wooden study desk, simple rectangle top with open notebook and pencil, four legs all visible down to floor with generous bottom margin. Desk full object, no cropped legs; matching stool optional only if fully visible. Reproduce style but correct anatomical and structural errors.

assets.prompt:
Create a square 4 by 4 contact sheet with EXACTLY 16 equal square cells, four rows and four columns. White background with clean thin white gutters exactly at quarter boundaries. Each cell is an independent warm watercolor illustration for Japanese young children, softly textured but clear recognizable subjects, natural shapes, gentle colors. Center each subject fully inside its cell with at least 10 percent safe empty margin so cropping never cuts it. No border frame, no text, no labels, no numbers, no logos, no overlap or shared backgrounds between cells. Use row-major order left to right, top to bottom. The sixteen cells must show exactly these subjects:
Row 1, column 1: A single wooden walking cane with a curved handle, standing diagonally.
Row 1, column 2: Several spring horsetail shoots with segmented tan stems and spore cones emerging from soil, Japanese tsukushi, not horse tails.
Row 1, column 3: A green ivy climbing vine with lobed leaves clinging to a short brick wall.
Row 1, column 4: A loose mound of rich brown garden soil with small crumbs, isolated.
Row 2, column 1: A hollow cardboard tube lying sideways with a clearly visible open circular end.
Row 2, column 2: A small azalea shrub covered in vivid pink trumpet shaped flowers.
Row 2, column 3: A neatly coiled thick twisted fiber rope, isolated.
Row 2, column 4: A red camellia flower with yellow stamens and glossy dark green leaves.
Row 3, column 1: A barn swallow in flight with narrow wings, forked tail and rusty throat.
Row 3, column 2: A small ceramic bowl of dark red sweet azuki bean paste with visible whole bean grains and a wooden spoon.
Row 3, column 3: A rounded brown ceramic storage jar with a narrow open mouth.
Row 3, column 4: A closed pink flower bud on a short green leafy stem, petals not yet open.
Row 4, column 1: A small tower made of colorful wooden toy blocks in cube triangle and cylinder shapes.
Row 4, column 2: A complete fishing rod with reel, gently curved tip and visible line, no fish.
Row 4, column 3: A single clean curved metal fishing hook with an eye and small barb, isolated.
Row 4, column 4: A morning glory vine stem curling around a wooden stake with green leaves and one blue flower.

assets.prompt:
Create one carefully aligned 4 column by 4 row contact sheet of separate children picture-book illustrations. Warm painted style, gentle expressive faces, complete anatomically correct subjects. EXACTLY equal-sized square cells, clean white gutters. Keep all scene content comfortably inside its own cell with 8 percent empty margins, never overlap cells. No labels, no captions, no letters, no watermark; numbers only when specifically requested. Every cell is independent; ordered left to right then top to bottom. No extra rows or thumbnail strips. Each cell should tell its own story. Scenes:
1. Child prepares to go out, putting on shoes beside backpack and coat in entryway
2. Energetic young girl with ponytail playfully climbs a sturdy low playground climbing frame; visibly a girl
3. Two toy motorcars tested on same track: old dented car struggling far behind sleek faster car; stopwatch and finish ribbon make lower performance clear
4. Child startled by jack-in-box springing open: wide eyes, raised eyebrows, open round mouth, shoulders lifted
5. Hungry child waits for food holding belly, frowning with discomfort, empty plate on table; no smile
6. Child sitting up in bed realizes overslept, startled worried face, bedside clock shows late morning and sunlight enters; bedding clear
7. Three children each work on their own different craft at shared table: one paints, one folds paper, one builds blocks
8. Grandparent orally tells a story to children gathered on sofa; mouth speaking and expressive gestures; story bubble shows a friendly dragon, no letter
9. Lifeguard extends rescue ring to child struggling in water: child eyes worried, mouth open gasping, arms holding ring; helper close and safety assured; gentle no graphic distress
10. Chocolate box opened with clearly visible chocolates as main product and small inexpensive plastic toy car included as bonus; child pleased
11. Passenger carefully steps down from a bus onto sidewalk, normal intact feet and steps, full body visible
12. At home doorway one friend leaves walking toward own house while friends wave goodbye; clear departure and farewell
13. Family enjoys shade of leafy tree and farmers benefit from sunshine and gentle rain growing crops; natural benefits
14. Clever child solves reaching toy on high shelf by safely using stable step stool rather than wobbly stack; thoughtful planning
15. Child bites into a large whole red apple, teeth touching apple and clear bite mark
16. Child chews a mouthful of rice at meal, lips closed, slight cheek motion marks, chopsticks lowered; no swallowing or open-mouth eating

Create a square contact sheet with exactly SIXTEEN distinct equally sized illustrations in a precise uniform 4 by 4 grid. Reading order left to right top to bottom. Scenes:
1. A friendly domestic tabby cat sitting.
2. Thin dark green rectangular sheets of dried edible nori seaweed stacked on plate.
3. A brown wild boar with snout and short visible tusks.
4. A bottlenose dolphin swimming in blue sea, blowhole and horizontal tail flukes.
5. A white rabbit with long upright ears.
6. A small brown Eurasian tree sparrow with chestnut head and black cheek spot perched.
7. A whole yellow onion and cut half with concentric layers.
8. Earth's moon as a detailed pale cratered sphere against dark sky, no face.
9. A red crowned crane with long neck, long legs, white body and black flight feathers.
10. Orange carrots with fresh green tops.
11. A small natural gray mouse with round ears, pointed muzzle and long thin tail.
12. A ripe red apple and cut half showing seed core.
13. A bunch of yellow bananas with one partly peeled.
14. A giant panda with natural black white fur eating bamboo.
15. A tall sunflower with yellow petals and dark central disc.
16. A natural penguin standing on rocky Antarctic shore, flippers and webbed feet.

assets.meaning: 川や湖にすむ魚で、口のまわりにひげのようなものがある。
assets.prompt: Edit the reference into one SINGLE educational watercolor illustration of a Japanese catfish (Silurus asotus), centered with generous margins on ivory, full fish. Critical exact correction: species has FOUR barbels total, two long upper-mouth corner barbels and ONLY TWO short lower-chin barbels. Reference currently wrongly shows SIX. REMOVE the outer pair of short lower barbels, retain ONLY the two middle chin barbels. Draw one long whisker extending left from upper mouth corner, one long whisker extending right from upper mouth corner; draw one short whisker from left underside chin and one short whisker from right underside chin. FOUR whiskers total, no additional lines or whiskers near jaw. Broad flattened head, natural smooth dark gray/brown skin WITHOUT scale texture, tiny single dorsal fin near front, long low anal fin below posterior body, rounded tail. Fish in oblique side view like reference. NO other objects, NO panels, NO text. Count FOUR whiskers before finishing.
assets.review: 目視確認済み: 長い上あごのひげ2本、短い下あごのひげ2本の計4本。小さい背びれ1枚、長い尻びれと丸い尾びれ。

assets.meaning: 本物に似せて作られたものや、本物ではないもの。
assets.prompt:
Create ONE square 4 by 4 contact sheet, EXACTLY 16 equally sized square illustrations, white straight narrow gutters. Row-major order, four columns and four rows. Warm clear Japanese elementary-school picture-book watercolor style. Every cell is independent and fits entirely inside its square with margin. No captions, titles, numbering or watermarks. Follow each cell scene literally, especially action direction and objects.
Cell 1 (row 1, column 1), 鼻歌: A smiling child softly HUMS while tidying books. Lips are CLOSED, cheeks relaxed, a few soft music-note symbols near the closed mouth. No microphone or wide-open singing mouth. Gentle humming.
Cell 2 (row 1, column 2), 甘塩: A small grilled salmon fillet and a tiny pinch of salt between fingers. Only three tiny grains sprinkled lightly, with a happy child tasting the mild salted fish. NO pile of salt or heap of crystals. Mild and lightly salted food.
Cell 3 (row 1, column 3), 洗いざらい: A child empties every single toy block from a box onto a table. The box is tilted and visibly completely empty. All blocks are now on the table, none left inside. Meaning everything without leaving anything out. NO washing or laundry.
Cell 4 (row 1, column 4), 居座り: A stubborn fully clothed adult remains sitting on a chair with arms folded and feet firmly planted. A host stands beside the open exit door and gestures kindly for the adult to leave; seated adult clearly refuses to move. No comfortable napping.
Cell 5 (row 2, column 1), 一石二鳥: One central action: planting one fruit tree. Two clear result bubbles linked from that one tree: on the left, a basket of apples harvested; on the right, a family resting in its cool shade. One effort produces TWO good benefits. No stone or birds.
Cell 6 (row 2, column 2), 鰻登り: A shop owner is amazed by a sales chart rising very steeply from low left to high right, with coin stacks that rise steeply in the same direction. Shows rapid steep growth. NO eel or waterfall.
Cell 7 (row 2, column 3), オウンゴール: A soccer defender in a BLUE jersey accidentally kicks the ball backward into the goal guarded by their own BLUE-jersey goalkeeper. Both BLUE teammates look dismayed. An opposing RED-jersey player outside the goal celebrates. Clear ball arrow leads from BLUE defender to own goal. No mixed teammate colors.
Cell 8 (row 2, column 4), 行政: A municipal city-hall public-service counter. A civil servant processes a resident's application and hands back an official certificate. Small thought bubbles show public garbage collection and repaired streetlights, representing everyday government services implementing rules. NO parliament debate or legislature building.
Cell 9 (row 3, column 1), 献血: A calm fully clothed ADULT volunteer donates blood at a medical donation center. Nurse assists the arm. Tubing from the covered adult forearm runs DOWN to a collection bag resting on a small scale BELOW the arm, on a low trolley. NO hanging IV bag above the arm, no transfusion flowing into the person, no wound or exposed needle or visible puncture. The collected red liquid stays only inside the sealed bag and tubing.
Cell 10 (row 3, column 2), 後退: Side view of a car pointing RIGHT (headlights and hood on the right, rear tail lights on the left). A big arrow under the car points LEFT, showing reversing backward opposite the car's forward direction. Driver looks back over shoulder. Keep hood/rear and arrow unambiguous.
Cell 11 (row 3, column 3), 後転: A backward gym roll in three small stages within one cell, on a soft mat, same person facing LEFT at start and at end. Stage left: crouching, facing left, feet flat and knees tucked. Middle: rolling BACK toward the RIGHT over a rounded back with knees tucked, feet travel over the head to the right, hands beside ears. Right: finishes crouched facing LEFT again. Never change facing direction. A curved arrow points from start to finish to the RIGHT.
Cell 12 (row 3, column 4), しりとり: Japanese shiritori word chain represented by exactly FOUR clear picture icons in order, with arrows: RED APPLE (りんご) → GORILLA (ごりら) → TRUMPET (らっぱ) → PANDA (ぱんだ). Two happy children point at the pictures. The Japanese words correctly connect GO, RA, PA. No writing is necessary; picture identities must be obvious. No monkey, orange, or deer.
Cell 13 (row 4, column 1), 血みどろ: A WHITE torn shirt lying by itself on a chair, mostly covered in RED blood stains. No body wearing it, no wounds or hurt person. A first-aid kit is nearby and a calm fully clothed adult folds a clean replacement white shirt. Non-graphic symbolic aftermath. Clearly white fabric with red stains, never a plain red shirt.
Cell 14 (row 4, column 2), 偽物: Compare a real red apple cut open with real seeds and juicy pale fruit, and a lookalike FAKE plastic red apple that has popped apart into two hollow red shells with a visible seam. A child is surprised by the plastic apple. The fake has no flesh or seeds. No two stuffed toys or identical real apples.
Cell 15 (row 4, column 3), 濡れ手に粟: Fictional metaphor: a relaxed ADULT lightly presses just ONE small button with ONE fingertip. The automatic device instantly delivers a huge pile of gold coins into a basket. Two visual emphases: tiny effort and very large reward. No gambling, no stealing, no grain, no wet hands. Illustrates making large profits with little effort.
Cell 16 (row 4, column 4), 根強い: Lasting popularity over generations: an elderly grandfather shows a sepia photograph of himself as a young boy happily playing KENDAMA, while his smiling young grandchild beside him plays the SAME traditional kendama now. Longtime affection for the same toy. One photo in the background, present people large in foreground. No tree or literal roots.

assets.prompt:
Create precisely aligned 3 by 3 contact sheet of NINE independent square Japanese children's educational watercolor illustrations. EXACT equal cells with white narrow gutters at one-third and two-thirds horizontally and vertically. Generous margin inside cells, complete unclipped subjects, clean anatomy, no text, no labels. Row-major:
1 two-part story inside cell: child accidentally tears friend's picture and looks sorry; then spends effort repairing damaged picture with paper and colors, friend happy, making up for damage, no money.
2 recognizable WATER in glass being poured, ORANGE JUICE pouring from carton into glass, and COOKING OIL golden liquid being poured from bottle into pan, all together, liquid everyday examples, no oil barrels or unsafe gasoline handling.
3 two sequential calendar pages LEFT earlier sunny date marked planned sports day and RIGHT later rainy planned date shifted even later; prominent red arrow LEFT to RIGHT from earlier date to later date within same calendar, arrowhead ends at later date, simple dates 10 and 17 if needed.
4 child gently declines another helping of vegetables by politely gesturing a SMALL serving with hands and gentle apologetic face instead of blunt rejection; parent understands, tactful indirect wording illustrated by tiny-serving thought bubble and remaining full plate.
5 diagram on plain white background: central dot, three red arrows starting near dot and radiating straight OUTWARD, arrowheads at outer ends; no circular arrows, NO text, illustrates direction away from center not forces.
6 extension cord connecting wall socket to table lamp far away, clear cable and connected plug/socket fully visible, unplugged shorter cable shown beside for comparison, safe no exposed wire.
7 many children at school festival, varied friendly faces with normal eyes, all entirely within cell, single crowd scene, no stray bottom fragments.
8 before and after shop display for one apple: LEFT price 100 coins represented as ten stacks of ten dots; RIGHT price only 50 coins represented as five stacks of ten dots, large downward arrow and apple in both views, clearly large decrease in price. use concise 100 and 50 numerals if needed.
9 close view two children warmly smiling with natural symmetrical pupils, gentle cute appearance, cheerful happy expressions, no strange eyes, clean simple background.

2. Thin dark green rectangular sheets of dried edible nori seaweed stacked on plate.
3. A brown wild boar with snout and short visible tusks.
4. A bottlenose dolphin swimming in blue sea, blowhole and horizontal tail flukes.
5. A white rabbit with long upright ears.
6. A small brown Eurasian tree sparrow with chestnut head and black cheek spot perched.
7. A whole yellow onion and cut half with concentric layers.
8. Earth's moon as a detailed pale cratered sphere against dark sky, no face.
9. A red crowned crane with long neck, long legs, white body and black flight feathers.
10. Orange carrots with fresh green tops.
11. A small natural gray mouse with round ears, pointed muzzle and long thin tail.
12. A ripe red apple and cut half showing seed core.
13. A bunch of yellow bananas with one partly peeled.
14. A giant panda with natural black white fur eating bamboo.
15. A tall sunflower with yellow petals and dark central disc.
16. A natural penguin standing on rocky Antarctic shore, flippers and webbed feet.

assets.meaning: 食用にする海藻。また、それを薄く広げて乾かした食品。
assets.prompt:
Create a square contact sheet with exactly SIXTEEN distinct equally sized illustrations in a precise uniform 4 by 4 grid. Reading order left to right top to bottom. All objects wholly inside their cell with ample margin, thin white gutters. Warm clean children's educational picture-book watercolor, gentle outlines, simple pale backgrounds, biologically accurate animals and plants, no human faces on animals, no text labels numbers logos watermarks. Scenes:
1. A friendly domestic tabby cat sitting.
2. Thin dark green rectangular sheets of dried edible nori seaweed stacked on plate.
3. A brown wild boar with snout and short visible tusks.
4. A bottlenose dolphin swimming in blue sea, blowhole and horizontal tail flukes.
5. A white rabbit with long upright ears.
6. A small brown Eurasian tree sparrow with chestnut head and black cheek spot perched.
7. A whole yellow onion and cut half with concentric layers.
8. Earth's moon as a detailed pale cratered sphere against dark sky, no face.
9. A red crowned crane with long neck, long legs, white body and black flight feathers.
10. Orange carrots with fresh green tops.
11. A small natural gray mouse with round ears, pointed muzzle and long thin tail.
12. A ripe red apple and cut half showing seed core.
13. A bunch of yellow bananas with one partly peeled.
14. A giant panda with natural black white fur eating bamboo.
15. A tall sunflower with yellow petals and dark central disc.
16. A natural penguin standing on rocky Antarctic shore, flippers and webbed feet.

assets.meaning: 多くの人を乗せて道路を走る自動車。
assets.prompt:
Create one square contact sheet containing EXACTLY 16 separate child-friendly watercolor illustrations in a strict 4 columns by 4 rows grid. All 16 square cells have equal size and aligned straight boundaries, thin pale gutters. Warm gentle watercolor on clean white or pale cream background, crisp recognizable subjects for a Japanese vocabulary learning app for young children. Keep each subject entirely inside its own cell, centered, with generous 12 percent padding on every edge for cropping. No text, no letters, no numbers, no captions, no brand names, no labels, no borders around the whole image. Do not merge cells. Each scene is independent. Follow the following order EXACTLY, row-major left to right then top to bottom. 
Row 1 column 1: A friendly full-size city bus, three-quarter view, blue and cream, many passenger windows, no writing.
Row 1 column 2: An empty woven wicker carrying basket with an arched handle.
Row 1 column 3: A roadside bus stop shelter with bench and a round pole sign bearing only a simple bus pictogram.
Row 1 column 4: Two straight wooden Japanese taiko drumsticks lying beside the edge of a taiko drum.
Row 2 column 1: A red soft travel tote bag with two handles and zip, no logo.
Row 2 column 2: A green grasshopper with prominent folded long hind legs on a small leaf.
Row 2 column 3: One wooden baseball bat beside a small white baseball, bat fully visible.
Row 2 column 4: A blooming red rose with green leaves and small visible thorns on its stem.
Row 3 column 1: Two beige adhesive first-aid bandages with central white pads, one crossed over another.
Row 3 column 2: A golden lattice-top baked apple pie on a small plate, with one cut slice showing apple filling.
Row 3 column 3: A whole pineapple with spiky green crown and one yellow cut ring.
Row 3 column 4: A simple silver plumbing pipe elbow joined to a straight hollow pipe section, visible open circular end.
Row 4 column 1: A neatly laid out two-piece blue striped pajama shirt and trousers.
Row 4 column 2: A plate of cooked spaghetti with tomato sauce and a fork at the side.
Row 4 column 3: Fresh curly parsley leaves and stems in a small bunch.
Row 4 column 4: A desktop personal computer with monitor, keyboard and mouse, screen showing simple colorful shapes only.

assets.meaning: 黄色い皮をむいて食べる、細長い果物。
assets.prompt:
Create a square contact sheet with exactly SIXTEEN distinct equally sized illustrations in a precise uniform 4 by 4 grid. Reading order left to right top to bottom. All objects wholly inside their cell with ample margin, thin white gutters. Warm clean children's educational picture-book watercolor, gentle outlines, simple pale backgrounds, biologically accurate animals and plants, no human faces on animals, no text labels numbers logos watermarks. Scenes:
1. A friendly domestic tabby cat sitting.
2. Thin dark green rectangular sheets of dried edible nori seaweed stacked on plate.
3. A brown wild boar with snout and short visible tusks.
4. A bottlenose dolphin swimming in blue sea, blowhole and horizontal tail flukes.
5. A white rabbit with long upright ears.
6. A small brown Eurasian tree sparrow with chestnut head and black cheek spot perched.
7. A whole yellow onion and cut half with concentric layers.
8. Earth's moon as a detailed pale cratered sphere against dark sky, no face.
9. A red crowned crane with long neck, long legs, white body and black flight feathers.
10. Orange carrots with fresh green tops.
11. A small natural gray mouse with round ears, pointed muzzle and long thin tail.
12. A ripe red apple and cut half showing seed core.
13. A bunch of yellow bananas with one partly peeled.
14. A giant panda with natural black white fur eating bamboo.
15. A tall sunflower with yellow petals and dark central disc.
16. A natural penguin standing on rocky Antarctic shore, flippers and webbed feet.

assets.prompt: Correct the dictionary illustrations using the supplied contact sheets as reference. Make NEW exactly 3 by 3 evenly spaced grid with nine independent equal square educational watercolor illustrations, warm ivory background, scientifically accurate, entire subjects inside generous margins. NO text numbers labels borders watermark. Row1: (1) Japanese weather loach Misgurnus anguillicaudatus, long slender brown spotted cylindrical body, small rounded tail, mouth facing viewer in three-quarter angle, exactly TEN short barbels (five pairs) attached naturally around mouth and spreading radially, NOT long catfish moustache. (2) Japanese catfish Silurus asotus, broad flattened head, scaleless dark gray elongated body, exactly FOUR barbels total: two long upper-mouth barbels extending sideways and two much shorter lower-chin barbels, no extra whiskers; full fish with tail. (3) Accurate wooden soprano recorder front view, complete straight instrument mouthpiece at top with rectangular labium window, seven FRONT finger positions: upper five single round holes and bottom TWO paired small double-holes (so nine circular apertures on front total), subtle joints between head body foot. Thumb hole is on BACK hence not visible. Row2: (4) Japanese railway crossing at intersection of road and two parallel railway rails, correctly built thin straight horizontal yellow-black striped barrier arm pivoting from a roadside compact motor housing, arm crosses ROAD lane while clear train tracks stay visible, black/yellow crossing X sign and two red lamps on separate upright pole. No fence as barrier, no train or traffic in crossing. (5) Fully clothed child in T-shirt and shorts happily spinning ONE bright hoop horizontally around waist, hoop encircles waist physically and does not pass through body, full child head to shoes visible. (6) Swimwear collection laid out: blue one-piece swimsuit, boys' swim trunks, long-sleeved zippered rash guard top; separate recognisable garments all complete. Row3: (7) Small natural Japanese medaka rice fish Oryzias latipes side profile, translucent slender silver-beige body with large eyes, flat-ish back and small upturned mouth, single SMALL dorsal fin near rear, fan-shaped caudal fin NOT forked, elongated anal fin near rear, no goldfish stout body. Show two fish in sparse aquatic plants. (8) Yakitori on white plate, three parallel bamboo skewers with grilled chicken chunks, each bamboo handle protrudes at ONE end only, sharp far tip hidden completely inside last chicken chunk. assets.meaning: 横になって眠るための家具。
assets.prompt:
Create one square contact sheet containing EXACTLY 16 separate child-friendly watercolor illustrations in a strict 4 columns by 4 rows grid. All 16 square cells have equal size and aligned straight boundaries, thin pale gutters. Warm gentle watercolor on clean white or pale cream background, crisp recognizable subjects for a Japanese vocabulary learning app for young children. Keep each subject entirely inside its own cell, centered, with generous 12 percent padding on every edge for cropping. No text, no letters, no numbers, no captions, no brand names, no labels, no borders around the whole image. Do not merge cells. Each scene is independent. Follow the following order EXACTLY, row-major left to right then top to bottom. 
Row 1 column 1: A generic passenger ferry boat floating on gentle water, cabin and hull fully visible.
Row 1 column 2: A railway level crossing with tracks crossing a road, lowered yellow-and-black barriers and red warning lamps.
Row 1 column 3: A black shallow frying pan with a single long handle, fully visible.
Row 1 column 4: A single bright striped hula hoop standing slightly tilted, complete circle visible.
Row 2 column 1: A friendly pink pig standing on grass, curly tail and small snout.
Row 2 column 2: A bunch of purple grapes with one green grape leaf.
Row 2 column 3: A playground swing with two ropes and a wooden seat suspended from a simple frame.
Row 2 column 4: A caramel custard pudding on a plate with brown caramel top, smooth round shape.
Row 3 column 1: A wrapped gift box with a big ribbon bow, no lettering.
Row 3 column 2: A friendly curly-furred cream poodle dog with floppy ears, full body.
Row 3 column 3: A rectangular swimming pool with blue water, ladder and lane rope, empty of people.
Row 3 column 4: A pair of cushioned over-ear headphones, fully visible, no logo.
Row 4 column 1: A friendly green snake gently coiled with a small raised head, full body.
Row 4 column 2: A generic red helicopter with main rotor, tail rotor and landing skids, fully visible.
Row 4 column 3: A cozy bed with pillow, white duvet and simple wooden headboard.
Row 4 column 4: A friendly calico cat with clear white, black and orange patches, full body.

Show two fish in sparse aquatic plants. (8) Yakitori on white plate, three parallel bamboo skewers with grilled chicken chunks, each bamboo handle protrudes at ONE end only, sharp far tip hidden completely inside last chicken chunk. assets.prompt:
Create one square 4 by 4 contact sheet containing exactly sixteen equally sized square illustrations. Precise regular grid, narrow white gutters, each scene entirely within its own cell. Row-major left-to-right top-to-bottom ordering below. Warm clean children's picture-book watercolor, soft colors, gentle outlines, simple off-white backgrounds, large clear subjects legible as 256px vocabulary cards. No text, letters, labels, numerals, captions, logos, watermarks or tile numbers anywhere. Anatomically plausible hands. Each cell illustrates exactly its own concept, no mixing between cells.
Cell 1: A child giving a wrapped farewell gift to a friend departing with a suitcase; both warmly smiling.
Cell 2: A bowl of transparent thin glass noodles, some held above the bowl with chopsticks. Clearly food.
Cell 3: Gentle spring rain falling onto cherry blossoms and fresh green buds outdoors; no food.
Cell 4: A baseball pitcher on the mound winding up to throw a baseball toward home plate; glove and ball visible.
Cell 5: A clear water pitcher with a prominent handle and pouring spout, pouring water into a glass; no baseball.
Cell 6: A seated adult ventriloquist holding a small wooden puppet on one knee; puppet mouth open as if speaking, adult lips closed.
Cell 7: A blindfolded child placing loose paper eyes and a nose onto a large outline of a smiling face on the floor for a Japanese New Year game.
Cell 8: Close-up of a green bamboo stalk showing several clearly swollen ring-shaped nodes dividing the stalk.
Cell 9: A bright orange marine buoy floating upright in water near a small boat; clearly an anchored floating marker.
Cell 10: Close-up of a red tomato with its green star-shaped calyx prominently emphasized; the leafy attachment visible.
Cell 11: An elementary clepsydra water clock: upper transparent vessel dripping water slowly into a lower measuring vessel with evenly spaced tick marks but no digits, on a wooden frame. Not an hourglass.
Cell 12: At a fork in a forest path, a wooden signpost with two blank arrow-shaped boards indicating the two paths.
Cell 13: A person wearing a traditional Japanese straw rain cape made of overlapping long straw hanging from shoulders, broad straw hat, gentle rain.
Cell 14: Close-up of a child's hand with three tiny cloth animal finger puppets fitted over fingertips, clear fingers and miniature puppets.
Cell 15: A traditional Japanese ramune glass soda bottle with marble trapped in pinched neck, filled with pale blue fizz, alongside a glass. No labels.
Cell 16: A small dish of pastel round pressed-sugar ramune candies with powdery texture, several scattered beside it; no bottle.

Each cell has its own white background and generous blank margins; all subjects fit entirely inside cell with at least 12 percent clearance. Straight equal grid boundaries; no grid lines. Consistent warm watercolor educational picture-book illustration, clear accurate object anatomy, restrained background, natural colors, readable at 256px. No text, no letters, no numbers, no captions, no watermark. Do not swap or combine cells. Subjects in exact row-major order:
1. Japanese jack mackerel, Trachurus japonicus, full side profile: streamlined silver body, blue-green back, forked tail, two dorsal fins, visible curved lateral line with hard scutes toward tail.
2. Whitespotted conger eel, Conger myriaster, full elongated brown body with a neat row of small white spots along the side, pale belly, continuous dorsal-tail-anal fin, pointed tapering tail, small pectoral fin, no pelvic fins. Fully visible curved body.
3. Apatosaurus life restoration, full side view: massive heavy four-legged body, long thick neck held forward, small elongated low head, very long slender whiplike tail. No back plates, no horns. Muted gray-brown speculative coloration.
4. Ankylosaurus life restoration, full side view: low wide four-legged body, short neck, bony armour knobs across back, small triangular head, short stout legs, long tail ending in broad rounded bony club. No upright stegosaurus plates. Muted earthy speculative coloration.
5. A tabletop mirror clearly reflecting a small red ball sitting in front of it; reflection has matching geometry.
6. Two soft folded terrycloth towels, one pale blue and one cream.
7. A wooden measuring ruler with many evenly spaced short measurement tick marks, no numerals.
8. A clear triangular drafting ruler beside a pencil and one straight line on paper, no text.
9. A simple wooden shape sorting puzzle board with circle triangle and square matching pieces.
10. A partially completed jigsaw puzzle showing a simple house, with loose interlocking puzzle pieces.
11. Close up of a jacket zipper: two toothed tracks join below a clearly visible slider, open above it.
12. A small canvas tote bag with two short carrying handles.
13. A roll of adhesive tape, loose end peeling off the roll.
14. A small tool box beside hammer and screwdriver, plain safe tabletop.
15. A twin bell alarm clock on a bedside table, hands and tick marks but no numerals.
16. Child sitting safely in car rear seat with a correctly fitted three point shoulder and lap seatbelt, no neck contact.

assets.prompt: Create a scientifically grounded educational watercolor illustration of ONE Apatosaurus in complete side profile on a white background. Wide horizontal composition within a square canvas, ample white clearance around every body part. Apatosaurus anatomy: bulky heavy barrel torso, long thick muscular neck projecting forward almost horizontally, small low elongated head, four stout column-like legs with hindlegs similar in length to forelegs, and an exceptionally LONG TAIL extending backwards for AT LEAST the combined head-neck-torso length, tapering into a delicate whip tip. Keep tail nearly horizontal and fully visible; entire silhouette should fit across the canvas, use smaller scale to fit, never shorten the tail. No horns, no armour, no upright neck, no dorsal plates. Muted gray-brown skin as speculative life restoration. No text, no labels, no numbers, no watermark. Accuracy more important than cuteness.

assets.prompt:
ONE square educational illustration contact sheet, EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 EQUAL square cells in exact row-major order. Each subject entirely inside its own cell with at least 12% white safety margins. Equal grid geometry. Consistent warm watercolor picture-book style, clear real-world shapes and construction, plain white backgrounds, simple recognizable visual dictionary illustrations for children. 1. A transparent glass of amber roasted barley tea with a plain small tea pitcher.
2. Three plain white Japanese mochi rice cakes, round soft and slightly flattened, on a small plate.
3. Two steamed Japanese manju buns, one cut in half showing dark sweet bean paste inside a thin pale dough skin.
4. Two white soft puffy square hanpen fish cakes on a simple plate, one cut edge showing fine sponge texture.
5. A bowl of smooth creamy pale yellow vegetable potage, thick soup with a spoon beside it.
6. A small bowl of cooked short hollow tubular macaroni pasta, openings clearly visible.
7. Cut pieces of makizushi with black nori on outside, white rice and cucumber or egg filling, no rice outside.
8. A bowl of cooked rice mixed throughout with small carrot and mushroom pieces.
9. Thick udon noodles stir fried with cabbage and small carrot pieces, brown sauce coating, no soup.
10. A small tabletop grill with cooked slices of beef on its grate, tongs beside it.
11. Two grilled Japanese mochi rice cakes with light browned blister marks and small puffed portions on a plate.
12. Two oval rice sweets covered entirely by thick dark red sweet bean paste, one partly cut revealing sticky rice center.
13. A plain bowl full of irregular white popped corn with pale yellow toasted centers.
14. Two crispy golden cylinder spring rolls, one cut diagonally showing vegetable filling inside thin wrapper.
15. Three nigiri sushi pieces: small oval white rice portions each topped with tuna slice or cooked shrimp or yellow egg strip.
16. A small bowl of glossy brown cooked beans in a little simmering syrup.

Create ONE square educational watercolor contact sheet with EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 equal cells in row-major order. White background with wide clearance around all objects, accurate real world structure, warm watercolor style consistent across all cells, no captions, no letters or numbers, no watermark, no branding. Equal straight grid divisions. Fit the COMPLETE relevant subject inside each cell. Do not merge or swap cells. Subjects in precise reading order:
1. Three small Japanese side dishes: cooked vegetables, grilled fish fillet and rolled egg, no rice bowl.
2. A traditional Japanese New Year lacquer food box divided into compartments holding black beans, rolled egg, cooked shrimp and sliced fish cake.
3. Raw pink pork slices and one small beef steak on a clean plate.
4. Two triangular Japanese rice balls with white rice and black nori strips.
5. A small afternoon snack: two cookies and a glass of milk on a plate.
6. A small pile of thin wispy pale brown shaved dried bonito flakes in a shallow bowl, not sliced fresh fish.
7. A bowl of soft watery white rice porridge with grains visible and a spoon beside it.
8. Two rectangular sticks of chewing gum, one in partially opened plain silver paper wrapper, no writing.
9. Translucent milky white cubed kudzu starch sweets with tan kinako powder and dark brown syrup on a plate.
10. A small bowl of smooth white whipped dairy cream with a visible soft swirl.
11. Several irregular chunks of dark brown unrefined sugar beside small brown granules.
12. A small bowl of glossy black cooked soybeans.
13. A small pitcher of thick dark brown sugar syrup pouring a slow thin stream into a little dish.
14. A plain red squeeze bottle with a small dollop of red tomato ketchup on a dish, no branding.
15. A small clear glass dish of translucent orange fruit jelly with a spoon.
16. A small red lacquer bowl of sweet red bean soup containing two small white mochi rice cakes.

assets.prompt: One precise educational watercolor illustration of a MODERN JAPANESE SOROBAN abacus, white background, no text or numerals. Viewed nearly straight from above, horizontal wooden rectangular frame, a horizontal reckoning bar separating a narrow UPPER compartment and wider LOWER compartment. Exactly SEVEN vertical rods. On EACH of the seven rods exactly ONE bead above the horizontal bar and exactly FOUR beads below the bar. All seven rods have identical bead counts. Every bead has the traditional JAPANESE flattened DIAMOND / biconical shape: pointed edges on left and right in profile, NOT rounded sphere or oval Chinese beads. Dark brown polished wooden diamond beads. Whole frame fully visible, ample margins, clean construction, restrained realistic watercolor illustration suitable for child's dictionary. Count upper 7 beads total and lower 28 beads total, no extra beads, no decorative dots.

Create ONE square educational watercolor contact sheet with EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 equal cells in row-major order. White background with wide clearance around all objects, accurate real world structure, warm watercolor style consistent across all cells, no captions, no letters or numbers, no watermark, no branding. Equal straight grid divisions. Fit the COMPLETE relevant subject inside each cell. Do not merge or swap cells. Subjects in precise reading order:
1. A plain sharpened wooden graphite pencil with exposed wood and dark graphite tip.
2. A white rectangular eraser in a plain blue paper sleeve, beside pencil marks partly erased.
3. A drafting compass with two legs joined at hinge: one needle point and one short pencil, partly open over a clean circle on blank paper. Not a navigation compass.
4. A Japanese soroban abacus with a crossbar, exactly one bead above and four beads below per vertical rod, same pattern on all rods, 7 rods.
5. A slim digital medical thermometer with a small blank display and rounded probe tip, no visible numbers.
6. A Japanese taiko barrel drum on wooden stand, leather membrane on both ends, two drumsticks beside it.
7. A bathroom body-weight scale with flat platform and small blank display on floor, no numbers.
8. A small oval tightly bundled brown palm-fiber scrubbing brush with stiff bristles.
9. A simple rounded coin bank with narrow coin slot on top and two plain coins beside it, no character branding.
10. A household dustpan with flat front lip and raised sides, short handle behind.
11. A few sheets of soft white tissue paper stacked with one slightly crumpled sheet.
12. A simple wooden snow sled with two curved metal runners and pull rope.
13. A plain compact camera with circular lens, shutter button and wrist strap, no logo.
14. A wood chopping axe with metal wedge blade and sturdy wooden handle, lying safely flat.
15. A farming hoe with long wooden handle and broad flat metal blade at right angle to handle, not a shovel.
16. A hand-held magnifying glass making a small simple printed dot visibly larger, clear lens and handle.

White background with wide clearance around all objects, accurate real world structure, warm watercolor style consistent across all cells, no captions, no letters or numbers, no watermark, no branding. Equal straight grid divisions. Fit the COMPLETE relevant subject inside each cell. Do not merge or swap cells. Subjects in precise reading order:
1. An elementary classroom with rows of small desks facing a green chalkboard and a teacher desk, no text.
2. A Japanese school lunch tray with milk carton, rice, soup and small side dish, no readable packaging.
3. An elementary school building with wide schoolyard and a few small children walking toward entrance, no lettering.
4. A thin flat blue plastic writing underlay partly tucked beneath blank notebook page, pencil beside it.
5. A wall-mounted class timetable sheet with a tidy colored grid of five day columns and several lesson rows, colored squares only, no text or numbers.
6. A school library room with book shelves, reading tables and chairs, no sales counter.
7. Several narrow long rectangular colored paper strips, a few have a small hole and thread at upper end, blank.
8. A correctly shaped table tennis table with net across middle, two paddles and one small white ball resting on table, no players.
9. A decorated Christmas tree with star at top, round ornaments and a few small gift boxes at base.
10. A blank green school chalkboard in wooden frame with chalk and eraser on lower ledge.
11. A neighborhood public park with slide, swing set and bench, grassy spaces, no text.
12. A school building with classroom windows and entrance, simple realistic exterior.
13. A large open schoolyard with soccer goal and running space, school building at edge.
14. A factory interior with machines and conveyor belt producing plain boxes, no workers or text.
15. A theater interior with stage, red curtain and rows of audience seats, no people.
16. An open illustrated encyclopedia with clear pictures of a simple leaf and flower on one page and a rock on another, no text.

assets.prompt:
Produce ONE 4x4 contact sheet of SIXTEEN TINY isolated watercolor vocabulary illustrations. THIS IS A MACHINE-CROPPED ASSET: prioritise these geometry requirements over illustration size. Every panel has HUGE PURE WHITE EMPTY MARGINS, at least ONE QUARTER of its width/height ON EVERY SIDE. The ENTIRE scene including all ground, clouds, scenery and shadows must be no larger than HALF the panel's width and HALF its height, centered precisely. Do not enlarge scene to fill panels. Five continuous perfectly straight PURE MAGENTA (#ff00ff) horizontal lines and five PURE MAGENTA vertical lines including outer frame, 8px thick, at 0,25,50,75,100% of full canvas, creating exactly 16 equal WHITE SQUARE cells. Magenta used ONLY in lines, never in art. No text or labels. No objects touch white margins. Gentle warm watercolor children's book style. Accurate subjects, row-major order:
1: A bus driver seated at the steering wheel in a bus cabin, safely looking ahead; wheels and seat normal.
2: A red brick chimney projecting from a tiled house roof with a light puff of smoke; chimney clearly centered.
3: A storybook adult king wearing a gold crown, royal cape and simple robe, standing holding a small scepter.
4: A storybook young prince with a small gold crown and elegant tunic, standing beside a distant small castle.
5: A storybook young princess wearing a small gold crown and elegant long dress, standing beside a distant small castle.
6: A gently rounded low green hill rising smoothly above flat surrounding land, with a small tree to show scale; not a mountain.
7: A narrow clear shallow stream flowing gently through grassy meadow, with small rocks beside it; not a huge river.
8: A small decorative ceramic bird figurine on a wooden shelf; unmistakable ornament, no real live bird.
9: A wrapped present box with a ribbon and bow, centered.
10: A storybook European stone castle with towers and a central keep, moat optional, no modern skyscrapers.
11: Three small colorful Japanese beanbag juggling toys otedama sewn from cloth patches, softly rounded palm-sized bags, no ball seams.
12: A matched pair of simple wooden chopsticks resting diagonally beside a plain small plate, exactly two sticks.
13: A single Japanese lacquer soup bowl, broad circular mouth and deep curved body, filled with clear soup; no handle.
14: A simple wooden table and chair with a low cabinet, grouped as household furniture; no objects or people.
15: A small plate of sweet cookies, candy and a slice of cake representing assorted sweets, no wrappers or text.
16: A friendly adult singer singing into a microphone on a small stage; mouth open, no text or music notation.

assets.meaning: 部屋などを仕切る、建物の面。
assets.prompt:
ONE sheet, EXACTLY sixteen separate mini watercolor illustrations in a strict 4x4 square grid. Mandatory for automated cutting: FIVE straight uninterrupted pure MAGENTA #ff00ff horizontal and FIVE vertical lines INCLUDING OUTER BORDERS, thin 8px, at 0/25/50/75/100 percent. Pure white cells. Magenta ONLY in grid lines, never inside art. EVERY subject INCLUDING all scenery and shadows must fit in the central HALF WIDTH AND HALF HEIGHT of its panel. HUGE PURE WHITE EMPTY safety margin of ONE QUARTER of each cell on ALL sides. Do not fill the panel. No captions or any text, symbols, numerals or watermark. Gentle warm watercolor picture-book style, clear plausible anatomy and objects. Subjects in row-major order:
1. A simple solid wall dividing two rooms in a small cutaway house, wall centered, one room with chair and other with lamp.
2. One whole dark green kabocha squash with one wedge beside it showing orange flesh and seeds; not orange Halloween pumpkin.
3. Back of a person's head showing thick healthy dark hair; shoulders only faint, hair is the main visible subject.
4. One fully clothed child standing front-facing, entire head, torso, two arms and two legs clearly visible, to show the whole body.
5. A friendly nurse in plain pale blue scrubs beside a seated patient, gently checking a bandaged arm; no needles, no logos, no white doctor coat.
6. One clear colorless pane of glass standing at an angle, with visible thin edges and subtle reflections, shapes behind remain visible; not ice.
7. A tiny calm lake meeting a grassy land edge, the shoreline is the main subject, show a clear interface between land and water.
8. A close view of a child's bent knee with one small fresh superficial scrape, no graphic injury or dripping blood.
9. A close view of a child's bent knee with a faint pale healed scar on otherwise unbroken skin, no fresh blood or open wound.
10. Two children of different ages standing together as siblings, holding hands, casual everyday clothes; no babies or parents.
11. A person in a coat leaning forward while walking in strong wind, hair and scarf streaming sideways, tree leaning in wind; no rain.
12. A small bank building shown as a place to deposit money: a wide entrance with a visible counter and a person carrying a plain coin purse, no signs, no text, no currency symbols.
13. A thick wooden stake driven vertically into earth, sharpened base embedded and top visible; a marker stake, not a living tree.
14. A small grouping of green grass and a leafy small tree growing rooted in soil, showing both grasses and woody plants.
15. A dense patch of tall green wild grasses growing on ground, no trees or flowers; a grassy thicket.
16. A friendly child's face shown frontally, two eyes, nose and mouth clearly visible, hair framing forehead; face filling center only.
Edit instruction: Edit this exact 4x4 vocabulary contact sheet. Preserve ALL SIXTEEN SUBJECTS and their EXACT PANEL ORDER and the magenta grid geometry. The only correction: shrink EVERY complete illustration, together with all shadows/scenery, so the entire content fits within the CENTRAL 50% WIDTH and CENTRAL 50% HEIGHT of its own existing white cell. Center each miniature. This must leave at least 25% cell width/height PURE WHITE EMPTY MARGIN on EACH OF FOUR SIDES, including the wall/house, knee pictures, bank building, wind scene and grasses. Do not just add outer margins around the whole sheet. Keep original cell dividers at 0/25/50/75/100%, pure magenta. No new text, no new subject, no swapping or omission. All original16 illustrations remain recognisable and complete.
